race.description: Buy Your Kosciusko Tickets Mdn Showcase Hcp
race.comment: TRALEE (10) looked to be nearing her break through win before disappointing last time when she was always well back at Tamworth. Deserves another chance. MOON TREATY (6) found the line nicely to grab third last time out over 1400m at Gunnedah. Expected to be there at the business end. AKUMA (1) has been better in his last two efforts when doing his best work late. Drawn to take closer order this time and is ready to play a more significant role. NORTOKO (7) finished fifth at the second run back from a break in a 1200m contest at Bathurst at his latest appearance. Nearing his peak now and is worth following up. RUFUS ATTICUS (9) continues to leave himself with too much to do but could play a role late if the pace is genuine.
